decision_question: Should Acme run a paid scheduling pilot with three clinics this quarter?
scope: Pilot design and go/no-go for this quarter only; full launch is out of scope.

criteria_and_tradeoffs.tradeoff: Paid pilots learn faster about price but recruit fewer clinics.

key_assumptions.statement: Clinics feel the pain strongly enough to pay.
key_assumptions.label: hypothesis

counterevidence.point: No price has been tested yet.
counterevidence.label: fact

alternatives.why_not_now: It would not test willingness to pay.

confidence.explanation: No external evidence was gathered; the recommendation rests on user-provided facts.

what_would_change: Two of three clinics declining the proposed price.

next_actions.action: Offer the pilot at the proposed price to all three clinics.
next_actions.success_signal: Two clinics sign within three weeks.

proposed_memory_updates.statement: Testing willingness to pay before a full launch.

limitations: No external evidence was gathered or verified.
